ABOUT AGENCY

Dubai paperwork handled from first form to final approval

Every Dubai business deals with several authorities, each with its own forms, portals and deadlines. We prepare the documents, submit them in the right order and follow every transaction until the authority has issued its decision.

Our services cover company setup and licence renewals, Ejari registration, notary and attestation, legal typing and translation, insurance, Emirates ID and residence file support. You get one team, itemised fees and a clear status at every step.

Why Choose Al Anfal Doc?

Starting a company, renewing a licence or processing a visa in the UAE involves many offices and strict rules. We handle the paperwork and the government follow-up, so you can focus on your business and your family.

Government-approved process

Every application follows the official UAE procedures, so your licence, visa or attestation is handled correctly the first time.

Fast turnaround

We prepare, check and submit your documents quickly and follow up with the authorities, so you spend less time waiting.

Clear, upfront pricing

You get a clear quote before we start. Government fees and our service fee are listed separately, with no hidden costs.

A dedicated case manager

One person looks after your file from start to finish and updates you at every step, so you always know where you stand.

Clear help in your language

Our team explains each requirement in plain English and Arabic, and helps with certified translation when it is needed.

Support after approval

We stay with you after the approval: renewals, amendments and reminders, so nothing expires unnoticed.

Have Questions? Look Here

Straight answers to the questions we hear most. If yours is not here, our team will be happy to help.

Your written quote lists our professional fee and the government fees separately, together with the payment options available for that quote. Government fees are charged in UAE dirhams at the amount the authority sets.

We review what you need, confirm the steps, documents and fees in writing, prepare and check your file, submit it to the right authority and follow it until the authority issues its decision. You receive copies of every submission.

Contact our team and we will tell you what can be changed at the stage your file has reached. Once an authority has received an application, changes and refunds depend on that authority's rules.

No. Every decision is made by the relevant UAE authority. We prepare complete and correct files and follow them up, which reduces avoidable rejections, but approval is never ours to promise.

It depends on the activity, the premises and the authority's review. A simple renewal can take a few working days, while a new company with approvals can take several weeks. We give you an estimate for your case before work starts.
